# poweradmin_zone_metadata (Resource)

Manages one PowerDNS metadata kind of a zone, such as `ALLOW-AXFR-FROM` or `ALSO-NOTIFY`, with all of its values. Requires Poweradmin 4.3.0+.

Creating the resource replaces any values the kind already has. Poweradmin checks the values at apply: it refuses kinds that PowerDNS maintains itself, more than one value for a single-value kind, values outside a kind's vocabulary, operator-only kinds for non-administrators and, on the PowerDNS API backend, custom kinds without the `X-` prefix. A kind that only takes effect next to another kind needs that kind first, so add `depends_on`. Do not manage `SOA-EDIT-API` here together with `poweradmin_zone.soa_edit_api`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "poweradmin_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
  type = "MASTER"
}

# Allow zone transfers to a secondary and to the zone's own NS records
resource "poweradmin_zone_metadata" "allow_axfr" {
  zone_id = poweradmin_zone.example.id
  kind    = "ALLOW-AXFR-FROM"
  values  = ["192.0.2.10", "AUTO-NS"]
}

# Send NOTIFY messages to extra servers
resource "poweradmin_zone_metadata" "also_notify" {
  zone_id = poweradmin_zone.example.id
  kind    = "ALSO-NOTIFY"
  values  = ["192.0.2.10"]
}

# A single-value kind; Poweradmin refuses a second value at apply
resource "poweradmin_zone_metadata" "axfr_source" {
  zone_id = poweradmin_zone.example.id
  kind    = "AXFR-SOURCE"
  values  = ["192.0.2.1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Metadata kind in upper case, e.g. `ALLOW-AXFR-FROM`, at most 32 characters. Poweradmin stores kinds in upper case.
- `values` (Set of String) Values of the kind; at least one. Poweradmin trims values, so they must not start or end with whitespace.
- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the zone the metadata belongs to

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `zone_id/kind`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a metadata kind of a zone by zone_id/kind
terraform import poweradmin_zone_metadata.allow_axfr 10/ALLOW-AXFR-FROM
```
